a tall wine bottle beside two stemmed cups, and a pile of fresh green herbs.
a bright spring window with lamb-shaped cookies and flowers on the sill, the season of freedom.

a synagogue courtyard in autumn light with families in good clothes walking in, seen from behind.
a small sweet cake with a honey glaze beside a cup of tea.

a bowl of chicken soup with a few noodles and a spoon.
a hand-washing cup with two handles beside a basin.

a salt shaker and a round bread knife beside a plain bread board.

a bunch of grapes and a pomegranate hanging from the leafy roof of a hut.

a carob pod and a handful of almonds in a small dish.

a tall memorial candle burning in a glass, a quiet corner of a synagogue behind it.

a pair of plain canvas shoes set neatly side by side beside a doorway.
a white prayer shawl folded on a bench with a plain closed prayer book.

a glass of water and a plain bread roll on a small plate, simple and quiet.
a quiet city street at dusk with shops shuttered and an empty road, calm and still.
